This can be formalized as a state-transition system with a conflict detection operator \(C\) that triggers an oscillation kernel \(O\), which in turn feeds into an ideation generator \(I\). The organism's 'aptitude' acts as a scaling parameter \(\alpha\) that modulates the strength of \(I\). Failure modes occur when \(\alpha\) is too low (stuck in conflict) or too high (unstable ideation).
